en: Great danger, especially of being harmed or destroyed; or to put something in danger.
ex: The sailors were in great peril during the storm.
水手們在暴風雨中處境十分危險。

en: An extra thing that goes with something larger, such as a phone case; or a person who helps someone commit a crime.
ex: She bought a bag and other accessories to match her dress.
她買了一個包包和其他配件來搭配洋裝。

en: Impressive in size, appearance or manner, making people admire or respect it.
ex: The castle stood on the hill, an imposing sight.
城堡矗立在山丘上，景象雄偉。

en: To lose strength, confidence or determination; or to speak in an uncertain voice.
ex: His voice faltered as he read out the names.
他讀出名字時聲音顫抖起來。

en: A person who leaves their own country to live in another.
ex: Many emigrants left Ireland during the famine.
大饑荒期間，許多人從愛爾蘭移居國外。

en: A child that your husband or wife had with a previous partner.
ex: She treats her stepchildren as if they were her own.
她把繼子女視如己出。

en: Done or existing alone; or a person who lives alone; or a prison cell for one person.
ex: He led a solitary life in a cabin in the woods.
他在林中小屋過著孤獨的生活。

en: To speak with difficulty, repeating the first sound of words; or a speech problem of this type.
ex: He stutters when he is nervous.
他緊張時會口吃。

en: Light food and drink offered at an event or on a journey; or something that makes you feel less tired.
ex: Refreshments will be served after the lecture.
講座結束後將供應茶點。

en: A failure to do something required, especially paying money owed; or the setting that is used if you do not choose another.
ex: The company defaulted on its loan payments.
該公司拖欠貸款還款。

en: A hole or empty space inside something solid, such as a tooth or the body.
ex: The dentist found a cavity in her back tooth.
牙醫發現她後面的牙齒有蛀洞。

en: Small balls of ice that fall from the sky like rain; or to call to someone to attract attention; or to praise publicly.
ex: She raised her arm to hail a taxi.
她舉起手臂招呼計程車。

en: To have a tendency to do something; or to slope; or a slope.
ex: I'm inclined to agree with you on this point.
在這點上我傾向於同意你。

en: To use something carefully so that it lasts longer; or a fruit jam.
ex: We should all try to conserve water during the drought.
乾旱期間，我們都應該努力節約用水。

en: The technology of sending information over long distances, by telephone, radio, television or the internet.
ex: The telecommunications industry has grown rapidly.
電信業已快速成長。

en: The natural color and appearance of the skin on your face; or the general character of a situation.
ex: She has a fair complexion and freckles.
她膚色白皙，還有雀斑。

en: A smooth, brown nut that can be roasted and eaten; or the tree it grows on; or a reddish-brown color.
ex: We bought a bag of roasted chestnuts from the street seller.
我們從街頭小販那裡買了一袋烤栗子。

en: To squeeze something tightly between your finger and thumb; or a small amount of something.
ex: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
在湯裡加一小撮鹽。

en: Having a lot of thick, healthy green plants; or luxurious and rich.
ex: The island is covered with lush tropical vegetation.
這座島嶼覆滿了茂密的熱帶植被。

en: A box made of thick paper or cardboard used for holding goods or liquids.
ex: She picked up a carton of milk from the shop.
她從店裡拿了一盒牛奶。

en: Believing in magic, luck or ghosts without scientific reason.
ex: Some people are superstitious about the number thirteen.
有些人對數字十三有所忌諱。

en: An opinion or point that you argue for; or a disagreement or argument.
ex: It is my contention that the plan will fail.
我認為這個計畫會失敗。

en: A small metal object used to fasten something; or to hold something tightly.
ex: She clasped her hands together and closed her eyes.
她雙手合十並閉上了眼睛。

en: The dead body of a person.
ex: Police found a corpse in the river.
警方在河裡發現了一具屍體。

en: Having two parts or two uses.
ex: The device has a dual purpose: it records and plays video.
這個裝置有兩種用途：錄影和播放影片。

en: A law passed by a parliament or other governing body and written down.
ex: The statute makes it illegal to drive without a license.
該法規定無照駕駛屬違法行為。

en: To calculate a number or amount; or to use a computer.
ex: The program computes the average of all the scores.
這個程式計算所有分數的平均值。

en: Very shocking and unacceptable; or going far beyond what is normal or reasonable.
ex: It is outrageous that prices have gone up again.
物價又漲了，這真是太過分了。

en: A gray powder mixed with water and sand to make concrete; or to make something firm or strong.
ex: They used cement to build the foundation of the house.
他們用水泥蓋房子的地基。

en: A man who has never been married; or a first university degree.
ex: He is a confirmed bachelor who loves his freedom.
他是個堅持單身、熱愛自由的男人。

en: To do something to an extreme degree; or to exaggerate.
ex: Don't overdo it on your first day at the gym.
第一天上健身房別運動過度。

en: To have a strong wish to achieve something great.
ex: She aspires to become a famous writer.
她渴望成為一位著名的作家。

en: An island, especially a small one (literary use).
ex: The ship sailed past a small green isle.
船駛過一座綠色的小島。

en: The exchange of letters or emails; the letters themselves; or a close similarity between two things.
ex: The office handles all correspondence with customers.
辦公室處理所有與客戶的往來信件。

en: To officially say that something is true or has been done; or to give someone an official qualification.
ex: The doctor certified that he was fit to work.
醫生證明他適合工作。

en: A person's child or children; or the young of an animal.
ex: Parents want their offspring to be happy and safe.
父母希望他們的孩子快樂又平安。

en: To live in a place (formal); or to think or talk about something for too long.
ex: Don't dwell on your mistakes; learn from them.
別老想著你的錯誤，要從中學習。

en: The moment when you suddenly understand something; or the fact of something becoming real or achieved.
ex: The realization that he had been wrong shocked him.
他意識到自己錯了，這讓他十分震驚。

en: A secret plan made by a group of people to do something harmful or illegal.
ex: Several men were arrested for conspiracy to commit fraud.
幾名男子因共謀詐欺而被捕。

en: About to happen or appear soon; or willing to give information or help.
ex: Details of the forthcoming event will be announced next week.
即將舉行的活動細節將於下週公布。
